subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar, em diferentes textos, os efeitos de sentido decorrentes do uso de recursos linguístico-discursivos de prescrição, causalidade, sequências descritivas e expositivas e ordenação de eventos.

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos linguístico-discursivos de prescrição, causalidade, sequências descritivas, expositivas e ordenação de eventos em textos
components.description_en: Identify linguistic-discursive resources of prescription, causality, descriptive sequences, expository sequences, and event ordering in texts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze sources to identify event sequences or cause-and-effect relationships

components.description_pt: Analisar o efeito de sentido produzido por um recurso linguístico-discursivo específico em um texto
components.description_en: Analyze the meaning effect produced by a specific linguistic-discursive resource in a given text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a specific word choice influences the meaning of a passage

components.description_pt: Comparar efeitos de sentido produzidos por diferentes recursos organizacionais em variedade de textos
components.description_en: Compare meaning effects produced by different organizational resources across a variety of texts
components.cc_component_description: Compare the organizational structures of two or more informational texts on related topics

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret social studies explanations by
* Determining types of sources for answering compelling and supporting questions about phenomena or events
* Analyzing sources for event sequences and/or causes/effects
* Evaluating disciplinary concepts and ideas associated with a compelling or supporting question
Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative and connotative meanings; analyze the impact of a specific word choice on meaning and tone.
Compare and contrast the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more texts.
